subject.title: fix(agents): honor run abort signal in image and pdf tools

question: Should OpenClaw standardize the optional AbortSignal field across the public media-understanding provider request contracts and rely on the Codex app-server startup-interrupt form used by this branch?
rationale: The implementation is a coherent bug fix, but these changes define behavior across external provider implementations and the Codex app-server protocol rather than only local tool code.

options.title: Confirm the additive contract
options.body: Accept the optional signal as the shared cancellation seam, retain existing no-signal behavior, and merge after normal checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep tool-level cancellation only and defer shared provider-contract or Codex protocol changes until their owners define a narrower supported seam.

recommendation.title: Confirm the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional signal as the shared cancellation seam, retain existing no-signal behavior, and merge after normal checks complete.
